purpose: Search for oracle (development-selected and hindsight-upper-bound) mixture weights over the existing rank- and score-aggregation composition operators, and compare them against selecting a single best individual heuristic.
decision_status_as_of_2026_07_24_audit: BLOCKED -- not because infrastructure is missing, but because (a) upstream readiness cannot be verified from a non-Wulver checkout (check_upstream_readiness returns False here only because /mmfs1 is not mounted, not because the cluster jobs are confirmed incomplete), and (b) job 1120123's raw numeric artifacts are not present locally, so its NO_GO conclusion is confirmed only as a qualitative status string, not as an independently re-derivable result. See WOLVERINE_ORACLE_MIXTURE_HANDOFF.md for the recovery plan.

readiness_gate.rule: Do not submit until both upstream final reports exist, exactly as gated in docs/current/COMPOSITION_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN.md.
readiness_gate.additional_local_prerequisite: native_composition_pilot.py (job 1120123) already found NO_GO for rank-only and component-wise composition on the historical 5-treatment design; this sweep must not repeat that pilot's exact design. It adds two operator families the pilot never tested: weighted_reciprocal_rank aggregation and normalized weighted_score aggregation (composition.py / score_aggregation.py, added in this session). Re-running the identical rank-only pilot design is out of scope. Job 1120123's raw artifacts are cluster-only and not present in this checkout; the NO_GO string is trusted but not independently re-derived locally.

policy_set.note: score_capable_subset must equal llmserveopt.policies.capabilities.SCORE_CAPABLE_EXPERTS at run time -- do not hand-copy it into a config; import and assert equality so the sweep fails loudly if the capability table changes.

treatments.description: Single fixed policy selected by development-split evidence only.
Existing regression_anwg selector (see memory: Phase 2B.16 / vLLM Our-Method Comparison Pilot) as the discrete-selection reference point.
Equal weight (1/k) over a fixed expert set, no tuning at all.
treatments.weight_search: none -- weights fixed at 1/k by construction

treatments.description: Random weights over a random sparse top-k subset of experts, redrawn per seed. This is a null/control treatment establishing what composition looks like with NO oracle or learned information -- any oracle/learned treatment must beat this by more than noise to be worth reporting.

Hindsight upper bound only: weight/top-k grid searched directly against the SAME evaluation window's reward. Mirrors the existing oracle_srtf convention in registry.py (ORACLE_POLICY_NAMES) -- non-deployable, reported strictly as an upper bound, never compared as if it were a deployable candidate, and never used to pick a production weight vector.

weight_search.forbidden_use: must never be selected via TRAIN/VALIDATION/ROBUST_DEV and must never be reported as a deployable treatment

treatments.description: Weights predicted by a development-trained regressor (e.g. per-expert reward regressor analogous to _train_reward_models in tools/native_composition_pilot.py) mapped to softmax or advantage weights, frozen before evaluation.

weighted_borda.normalization: normalized rank in [0,1] per expert, deterministic (arrival_time, request_id) tie-break

weighted_score.excluded_normalization: none -- raw unnormalized score addition is not swept; docs/current/composition_operators.json documents this as unsafe by default

scenario_set.source: reuse the same design.csv driving tools/native_composition_pilot.py (policy_library_v2_expanded_20260721T171933Z/design/policy_library_v2_design.csv) so scenario coverage is identical to the already-completed rank/component pilot and results are directly comparable
scenario_set.leakage_guard: llmserveopt.selector.composition_experiment.assert_no_split_group_leakage must pass before any treatment selection

seeds.note: Fixed seed per draw so random_sparse_composition rows are individually reproducible; report mean and spread across all 5 seeds, not a single draw.

resume_behavior.convention: matches scripts/run_module_credit_overnight.py: --resume-dir flag, checkpoints/ subdirectory, heartbeat.json written periodically, per-(scenario,seed,treatment) row skipped if already present in policy_vectors.csv
resume_behavior.checkpoint_granularity: one row per (scenario_id, seed, treatment_id, composition_method, normalization_mode, top_k)

not_parallelizable: development-only weight/regressor fitting for T5_learned_weight_composition, which must complete before T5 evaluation rows are generated

decisive_question: Does any oracle-informed or learned-weight mixture (T4, T5) beat T0 (best individual policy) by more than the T3 (random sparse) null margin, on held-out splits, using the new weighted_reciprocal_rank and weighted_score operators in addition to the already-tested weighted_borda operator?
